shortDescription: Hong Kong plans to expand the Dim Sum bond market and develop yuan-denominated gold and commodity markets, Financial Secretary Paul Chan wrote in his weekly blog Sunday, according to Bloomberg.Chan said the moves are aimed at further enhancing the city’s financial role and pricing power.

title: Hong Kong Plans Broader Dim Sum Bond Market, Chan Says
